words.enDefinition: a record showing what an employee earned, what was deducted and what was paid

examples.en: My first payslip arrived in the staff portal two days after my deposit.
examples.zh: 第一笔工资到账两天后，我在员工平台上收到了第一张「工资单」。

examples.en: I saved my payslip as a PDF before losing access to the old account.
examples.zh: 旧账号停用前，我把「工资单」保存成了 PDF。

words.enDefinition: the day on which a worker receives their pay

examples.en: The library posts its shift schedule a week before payday each month.
examples.zh: 图书馆每月会在「发薪日」前一周公布排班。

examples.en: My manager said payday falls on Friday for everyone in our department.
examples.zh: 经理说，我们部门所有人的「发薪日」都是周五。

words.enDefinition: the part of an organization responsible for calculating and paying wages

examples.en: The payroll department asked for the dates covered by my missing payment.
examples.zh: 「薪资部门」问我没收到的那笔工资对应哪些日期。

examples.en: I forwarded the message to the payroll department after speaking to my supervisor.
examples.zh: 和主管谈过后，我把消息转发给了「薪资部门」。

collocations: send a form to the payroll department

words.enDefinition: a reference number used to identify a worker in an employer's pay records

examples.en: I found my payroll number next to my name on the first payslip.
examples.zh: 我在第一张工资单上找到了姓名旁边的「薪资编号」。

examples.en: The payroll number on the form belongs to my previous campus job.
examples.zh: 表上的「薪资编号」属于我上一份校内工作。

words.enDefinition: an online system where staff can see and manage their pay information

examples.en: The payroll portal showed the deposit total before I received the bank notification.
examples.zh: 我收到银行通知之前，「薪资查询平台」就显示了到账金额。

examples.en: I had to use my staff login to open the payroll portal.
examples.zh: 我得用员工账号登录「薪资查询平台」。

collocations: log in to the payroll portal
view payslips in the payroll portal

words.enDefinition: the latest time for changes to be included in a particular pay run

examples.en: My supervisor approved the corrected hours a day after the payroll cutoff.
examples.zh: 「薪资结算截止时间」过了一天，主管才批准我更正后的工时。

examples.en: The office sent a reminder about the payroll cutoff for December's payments.
examples.zh: 办公室发了提醒，说明十二月工资的「薪资结算截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule showing when pay is processed and issued

examples.en: I checked the payroll calendar to see whether our next payment moved.
examples.zh: 我查了「发薪日历」，看看下次发薪日期有没有变。

examples.en: The payroll calendar lists a different deadline for student workers this month.
examples.zh: 「发薪日历」上列的本月学生员工截止日期不同。

words.enDefinition: total employee pay before tax or other amounts are deducted

examples.en: I compared my gross pay with the hours and rates listed above it.
examples.zh: 我把「工资总额」和上面列的工时、工资标准核对了一下。

examples.en: The weekend shift increased my gross pay on this month's statement.
examples.zh: 周末的班次让这月工资单上的「工资总额」多了一些。

words.enDefinition: the amount of pay left after taxes and other deductions

examples.en: My net pay matched the amount that appeared in my bank account.
examples.zh: 我的「实发工资」与银行账户里显示的到账金额一致。

examples.en: The sample statement puts net pay in bold at the bottom right.
examples.zh: 工资单样本把「实发工资」用粗体标在右下角。

words.enDefinition: the standard amount paid for a job before extras are added

examples.en: The payslip showed my basic pay on a separate line from the bonus.
examples.zh: 工资单把「基本工资」和奖金分成两行列出来。

examples.en: The contract lists basic pay before it explains weekend and evening rates.
examples.zh: 合同先列「基本工资」，再说明周末和晚班的工资标准。

words.enDefinition: pay for ordinary working hours apart from overtime and other extras

examples.en: The first line shows regular earnings for the hours I worked during term.
examples.zh: 第一行列出了我这学期上班的「正常工时收入」。

examples.en: I asked why the extra shift appeared under regular earnings this month.
examples.zh: 我问新增的班次为什么这月列在「正常工时收入」一栏。

words.enDefinition: pay for working beyond the usual or specified working hours

examples.en: The extra hours appeared as overtime pay on my next weekly statement.
examples.zh: 多上班的那几个小时在我下一周的工资单上列为「加班工资」。

examples.en: We asked payroll when the overtime pay from Saturday would be processed.
examples.zh: 我们问薪资部门，周六那笔「加班工资」什么时候处理。

words.enDefinition: in the UK payroll sense, pay an employee receives while taking annual leave

examples.en: The holiday pay line on my payslip was for days of paid leave.
examples.zh: 工资单上的「休假工资」一栏对应带薪休假。

examples.en: The UK handbook explains how holiday pay appears on the final payslip.
examples.zh: 英国员工手册解释了「休假工资」在最后一张工资单上的显示方式。

words.enDefinition: extra pay for working a particular shift, such as at night

examples.en: The evening shift differential showed up on a separate line this week.
examples.zh: 这周的工资单把晚班的「班次工资加成」单列了一行。

examples.en: My colleague asked whether the shift differential applied to the late library shift.
examples.zh: 同事问图书馆的深夜班有没有「班次工资加成」。

words.enDefinition: additional pay for a past period after a change was made effective from an earlier date

examples.en: The new rate took effect last month, so my statement included retroactive pay.
examples.zh: 新工资标准从上个月生效，所以工资单包含「追溯补发的工资」。

examples.en: I asked which weeks the retroactive pay on my latest statement covered.
examples.zh: 我问最近工资单上的「追溯补发的工资」对应哪几周。

words.enDefinition: wages owed for earlier work that were not paid when due

examples.en: The office confirmed that two missed shifts were included in my back pay.
examples.zh: 办公室确认，我的「补发的欠薪」包含之前漏算的两个班次。

examples.en: The letter listed each week covered by the back pay from my former employer.
examples.zh: 信里列出了前雇主那笔「补发的欠薪」对应的每一周。

words.enDefinition: the last wage payment a person receives from an employer after leaving a job

examples.en: My final paycheck from the summer job arrived after classes had started.
examples.zh: 开学后，我才收到暑期工作发的「最后一笔工资」。

examples.en: I kept the email showing when my final paycheck had been processed.
examples.zh: 我留着那封邮件，上面写了「最后一笔工资」的处理日期。

words.enDefinition: the pay recorded from the start of the current reporting year up to a given date

examples.en: The year-to-date pay figure includes my earnings from the first semester.
examples.zh: 「本年累计工资」的数字包含我第一学期的收入。

examples.en: I saw year-to-date pay beside the figures for the current pay period.
examples.zh: 我在本期工资金额旁边看到了「本年累计工资」。

words.enDefinition: the number of hours someone actually spends working

examples.en: The hours worked on my payslip matched what I entered on Monday.
examples.zh: 工资单上的「实际工作时数」和我周一填写的一致。

examples.en: Our supervisor confirmed the hours worked before sending the records to payroll.
examples.zh: 主管先确认了「实际工作时数」，再把记录发给薪资部门。

words.enDefinition: the amount someone is paid per unit of time or per unit of work

examples.en: The contract stated a different pay rate for the evening desk shift.
examples.zh: 合同为晚间值班规定了不同的「工资标准」。

examples.en: I checked the pay rate shown beside my hours on the statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了工资单上工时旁边列的「工资标准」。

collocations: an increase in your pay rate

words.enDefinition: how often someone receives scheduled pay

examples.en: The student job handbook lists pay frequency alongside the expected working hours.
examples.zh: 学生工作手册在预计工作时间旁边注明了「发薪频率」。

examples.en: The two campus employers use different pay frequency settings in their systems.
examples.zh: 这两家校内雇主在各自系统里设置的「发薪频率」不同。

words.enDefinition: pay issued every two weeks in a regular schedule

examples.en: The department uses biweekly pay, so my deposits do not fall on fixed dates.
examples.zh: 部门实行「每两周发薪」，所以我的工资到账日并非每月固定日期。

examples.en: The new job switched me from monthly deposits to biweekly pay this fall.
examples.zh: 今年秋天换了工作后，我的工资从每月发一次变成了「每两周发薪」。

words.enDefinition: pay issued twice each month, usually on two set dates

examples.en: Our semimonthly pay usually arrives in the middle and at the end of each month.
examples.zh: 我们一般在月中和月底收到工资，实行「每月发薪两次」。

examples.en: The handbook explained why semimonthly pay produces two scheduled deposits each month.
examples.zh: 手册解释了为什么「每月发薪两次」每月会安排两笔工资入账。

words.enDefinition: money taken out of an employee's pay by the employer

examples.en: I asked what the payroll deduction on the second line was for.
examples.zh: 我问第二行的「工资扣款」是因为什么。

examples.en: My payslip showed a new payroll deduction after I joined the pension scheme.
examples.zh: 我加入养老金计划后，工资单上多了一项「工资扣款」。

words.enDefinition: an amount taken from pay before the relevant tax is calculated

examples.en: The benefits guide gave an example of a pre-tax deduction for commuting costs.
examples.zh: 福利指南举了一个通勤费「税前扣款」的例子。

examples.en: I asked why this amount appeared under pre-tax deduction on the staff portal.
examples.zh: 我问这笔金额为什么在员工平台上归到「税前扣款」一栏。

words.enDefinition: an amount taken from pay after the relevant tax has been calculated

examples.en: The staff donation appeared as a post-tax deduction on my December payslip.
examples.zh: 我的十二月工资单把员工捐款列为「税后扣款」。

examples.en: The presenter used a post-tax deduction to explain how the last total was calculated.
examples.zh: 讲解人用一项「税后扣款」来说明最后一个合计金额是怎么算出来的。

words.enDefinition: a short identifier used to specify a kind of amount withheld from pay

examples.en: The deduction code on my payslip was explained in the staff handbook.
examples.zh: 员工手册对我工资单上的「扣款代码」作了解释。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to read out the deduction code beside that amount.
examples.zh: 办事员请我读出那笔金额旁边的「扣款代码」。

words.enDefinition: a non-wage benefit treated as income for tax purposes under applicable rules

examples.en: The guide described the parking subsidy as a taxable benefit in this example.
examples.zh: 指南在这个例子里把停车补助列为「应纳税福利」。

examples.en: I asked why the taxable benefit appeared on the statement beside my wages.
examples.zh: 我问为什么这项「应纳税福利」会和工资一起列在报表上。

collocations: the value of a taxable benefit

words.enDefinition: a benefit provided by an employer in a form other than cash

examples.en: The guide listed a company car as an example of a benefit in kind.
examples.zh: 指南把公司配车列为「非现金福利」的一个例子。

examples.en: The payslip summary shows the estimated value of each benefit in kind.
examples.zh: 工资单摘要列出了每项「非现金福利」的估算价值。

collocations: the value of a benefit in kind

words.enDefinition: a request for an employer or organization to repay money spent for its work

examples.en: I sent an expense claim for the train tickets used during the workshop.
examples.zh: 我提交了「费用报销申请」，报销参加工作坊时用的火车票。

examples.en: The finance assistant found a missing receipt attached to my expense claim.
examples.zh: 财务助理在我的「费用报销申请」附件里找到了那张遗漏的收据。

words.enDefinition: a correction that changes the amount an employee actually receives

examples.en: The new statement included a net pay adjustment for the previous month.
examples.zh: 新的工资单包含一项针对上月的「实发工资调整」。

examples.en: I asked how the net pay adjustment was shown on my bank statement.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「实发工资调整」在银行流水上是怎么显示的。

words.enDefinition: a payment lower than the amount that should have been paid

examples.en: Payroll confirmed the underpayment after comparing the payslip with my approved hours.
examples.zh: 薪资部门把工资单与核准的工时作了对比，确认有一笔「少付的款项」。

examples.en: The letter gave the amount of the underpayment and a separate correction date.
examples.zh: 信里写明了「少付的款项」金额和另行补发的日期。

words.enDefinition: a payment greater than the amount that should have been paid

examples.en: The payroll office emailed me about the overpayment on my first wage statement.
examples.zh: 薪资部门发邮件，提到我第一张工资单上「多付的款项」。

examples.en: The second statement explained the overpayment and listed the amount involved separately.
examples.zh: 第二张工资单说明了「多付的款项」，并单列了相关金额。

words.enDefinition: a difference between the information on a payslip and the expected figures

examples.en: I noticed a payslip discrepancy when I compared my hours with the schedule.
examples.zh: 我拿工时和排班表核对时发现了「工资单上的差错」。

examples.en: My supervisor checked the approved shifts before replying about the payslip discrepancy.
examples.zh: 主管回复「工资单上的差错」之前，先核对了已批准的班次。

words.enDefinition: a new version of a payslip with one or more errors fixed

examples.en: A corrected payslip appeared in my account after payroll reviewed the missing shift.
examples.zh: 薪资部门核查漏算的班次后，我的账号里出现了一张「更正后的工资单」。

examples.en: I kept the corrected payslip and moved the old one into a separate folder.
examples.zh: 我留存了「更正后的工资单」，把原来的那张移到了另一个文件夹。

words.enDefinition: a wage payment that has not arrived when expected

examples.en: The clerk asked for my last pay date when I reported a missing paycheck.
examples.zh: 我报告「未收到的工资」时，办事员问我上次发薪是哪天。

examples.en: I found my payslip online but still had to ask about the missing paycheck.
examples.zh: 我在网上找到了工资单，但还是得问一下那笔「未收到的工资」。

words.enDefinition: documents or other evidence showing how much someone has earned from work

examples.en: Payroll sent proof of earnings that listed my wages from both part-time jobs.
examples.zh: 薪资部门发来「工作收入证明」，上面列了我两份兼职的工资。

examples.en: I asked whether the signed letter from my supervisor counted as proof of earnings.
examples.zh: 我问主管签字的信能不能算作「工作收入证明」。

collocations: accept payslips as proof of earnings

words.enDefinition: money and other compensation received from working as an employee

examples.en: The job at the bookstore was my only source of employment income that winter.
examples.zh: 那年冬天，书店的工作是我唯一的「受雇收入」来源。

examples.en: The annual slip shows my employment income from one of my campus jobs.
examples.zh: 年结单上有我一份校内工作的「受雇收入」。

words.enDefinition: money earned by working for oneself through freelance work, a trade or a business

examples.en: The worksheet places self-employment income in a section separate from regular wages.
examples.zh: 计算表把「自雇收入」和普通工资放在不同的栏目。

examples.en: I asked how the service defined self-employment income for freelance design work.
examples.zh: 我问服务部门怎么界定自由接单做设计的「自雇收入」。

words.enDefinition: money received through an award that supports a person's studies

examples.en: My annual statement listed scholarship income separately from pay for shifts at the library.
examples.zh: 我的年度报表把「奖学金收入」与在图书馆值班的工资分开列出。

examples.en: The tax workshop explained that scholarship income can include awards from outside the university.
examples.zh: 税务讲座说明了「奖学金收入」也可能包括校外机构给的奖学金。

words.enDefinition: money that applicable rules require a person to disclose on a financial or tax form

examples.en: During the workshop, we discussed how the form distinguishes reportable income from gifts.
examples.zh: 讲座上，我们讨论了那张表如何区分「须申报的收入」与赠与。

examples.en: I wrote down the question about reportable income before speaking with the adviser.
examples.zh: 在和顾问交谈前，我先记下了关于「须申报的收入」的问题。

words.enDefinition: income from relevant sources before applicable deductions are subtracted

examples.en: The worksheet starts with gross income and lists the adjustments underneath it.
examples.zh: 计算表先列「总收入」，下面再列各项调整。

examples.en: I checked whether the form asked for household gross income or my own.
examples.zh: 我核实了一下，表格问的是家庭「总收入」，还是我个人的。

words.enDefinition: in the US, gross income minus certain adjustments allowed before calculating taxable income

examples.en: The sample return lists adjusted gross income near the end of its first page.
examples.zh: 样本税表快到第一页末尾的地方列了「美国调整后总收入」。

examples.en: I saw adjusted gross income mentioned in several questions on the American form.
examples.zh: 我看到那张美国表格上的几个问题都提到了「美国调整后总收入」。

collocations: adjusted gross income for the previous year

words.enDefinition: income that is excluded from a particular tax under applicable rules

examples.en: The workshop used a sample form to show where tax-exempt income might appear.
examples.zh: 讲座用一张样表展示了「免税收入」可能会出现在哪里。

examples.en: I asked how the guide defined tax-exempt income for that specific form.
examples.zh: 我问指南对那张表格上的「免税收入」是怎么定义的。

words.enDefinition: tax taken out of a payment and sent to the tax authority on the recipient's behalf

examples.en: My first payslip listed tax withholding under a subtotal for all deductions.
examples.zh: 我第一张工资单在所有扣款的小计下面列出了「预扣税」。

examples.en: The guide explains how tax withholding may appear on your annual wage statement.
examples.zh: 指南解释了「预扣税」可能会在年度工资报表上怎么显示。

words.enDefinition: the sum taken out of a payment before the balance is paid to the recipient

examples.en: The withholding amount on this week's statement was different from the previous one.
examples.zh: 这周工资单上的「预扣金额」和上一张不一样。

examples.en: The office said the withholding amount appeared just above the total deductions.
examples.zh: 办公室说，「预扣金额」就在扣款合计的上方。

words.enDefinition: a tax on income earned or received by a person or organization

examples.en: The guide explains why income tax and pension contributions appear separately on this payslip.
examples.zh: 指南解释了为什么「所得税」和养老金缴费在这张工资单上是分开列的。

examples.en: I attended an information session about income tax for students with part-time jobs.
examples.zh: 我参加了一场介绍打工学生「所得税」的说明会。

words.enDefinition: an income tax charged by the federal government of a country

examples.en: The US payslip listed federal income tax on a line above state deductions.
examples.zh: 那张美国工资单在州级扣款上面一行列了「联邦所得税」。

examples.en: Our workshop used a Canadian example to show where federal income tax appeared.
examples.zh: 讲座用一个加拿大的例子展示「联邦所得税」列在哪里。

words.enDefinition: an income tax charged by a state where the tax applies

examples.en: The US payroll form had a separate line for state income tax withheld.
examples.zh: 那张美国工资表单列了一行预扣的「州所得税」。

examples.en: My tutor used two American payslips to explain differences in state income tax.
examples.zh: 导师用两张美国工资单讲解了「州所得税」的差异。

words.enDefinition: an income tax charged by a province

examples.en: The Canadian example shows provincial income tax in a separate part of the calculation.
examples.zh: 那个加拿大例子在计算式的另一部分列了「省级所得税」。

examples.en: I asked whether the figures listed there included provincial income tax from both jobs.
examples.zh: 我问那里列出的数字是否包含两份工作对应的「省级所得税」。

words.enDefinition: a tax on income charged by a local government, such as a city

examples.en: The example from that city listed local income tax alongside other payroll deductions.
examples.zh: 那个城市的样本在其他工资扣款旁边列了「地方所得税」。

examples.en: I asked if local income tax was the name of the line on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问工资单上那一行的名称是不是「地方所得税」。

words.enDefinition: a payment made during a tax year based on the amount of tax expected to be due

examples.en: A worksheet in the US tax guide showed how an estimated tax payment was recorded.
examples.zh: 美国税务指南里的一张表展示了怎样记录一笔「预缴税款」。

examples.en: The illustration shows where to enter an estimated tax payment made in April.
examples.zh: 图示标明了四月的「预缴税款」应该记在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a range of taxable income to which a particular tax rate applies

examples.en: The chart showed where the first tax bracket ended and the next one began.
examples.zh: 图表标出了第一个「所得税税率档」在哪里结束、下一档从哪里开始。

examples.en: We highlighted the first tax bracket before working through the figures on the board.
examples.zh: 我们先标出第一个「所得税税率档」，再算黑板上的数字。

collocations: move into a higher tax bracket

words.enDefinition: the rate that applies to an additional unit of taxable income at a given income level

examples.en: A tutor used a small pay increase to illustrate the marginal tax rate.
examples.zh: 导师用一小笔加薪说明了什么是「边际税率」。

examples.en: The diagram compares a person's marginal tax rate at two different income levels.
examples.zh: 图表对比了同一个人在两种收入水平下的「边际税率」。

collocations: a marginal tax rate of twenty percent

words.enDefinition: total tax as a share of the income or amount used in the calculation

examples.en: The article compared the effective tax rate paid by households in different income groups.
examples.zh: 文章比较了不同收入群体的家庭承担的「实际税率」。

examples.en: We asked which income figure was used to calculate the effective tax rate.
examples.zh: 我们问计算「实际税率」时用的是哪个收入数字。

words.enDefinition: the amount of tax a person or organization is responsible for paying

examples.en: The worksheet calculates tax liability before subtracting payments already made during the year.
examples.zh: 计算表先算「应纳税额」，再减去这一年已经缴过的款项。

examples.en: I asked the volunteer where my estimated tax liability appeared on the printout.
examples.zh: 我问志愿者，打印件的哪里列了我预计的「应纳税额」。

words.enDefinition: a statement that tells a person how much tax they owe

examples.en: The tax bill arrived online when I was checking messages from the city.
examples.zh: 我查收市政府发来的消息时，在网上收到了「税款账单」。

examples.en: I asked the office which period the tax bill covered before checking my records.
examples.zh: 在核对记录前，我先问办公室这张「税款账单」涵盖哪个时段。

words.enDefinition: the current stage of processing a tax refund

examples.en: The website asked for the filing year before it showed my tax refund status.
examples.zh: 网站让我先填写申报年度，才显示「退税进度」。

examples.en: I checked my tax refund status again after receiving an update from the agency.
examples.zh: 收到税务部门的更新后，我又查了一次「退税进度」。

collocations: an update on tax refund status

words.enDefinition: an amount that reduces the tax owed, subject to the applicable rules

examples.en: The example shows where a tax credit is applied in the calculation.
examples.zh: 例子标出了计算过程中在哪一步应用「税额抵免」。

examples.en: The software asked about a tax credit before it displayed the final estimate.
examples.zh: 软件在显示最终估算金额前，先问了我一项「税额抵免」的情况。

words.enDefinition: a tax credit that can be paid out when it exceeds the tax owed, subject to the applicable rules

examples.en: The workshop showed how a refundable tax credit could result in a refund.
examples.zh: 讲座演示了「可退还的税额抵免」怎样带来退税。

examples.en: I asked the tutor how a refundable tax credit was represented in the example.
examples.zh: 我问导师，例子里是怎么表示「可退还的税额抵免」的。

collocations: qualify for a refundable tax credit
the value of a refundable tax credit

words.enDefinition: a tax credit that reduces tax owed and does not pay out any unused amount

examples.en: The guide explains how a nonrefundable tax credit changes the total in this example.
examples.zh: 指南说明，这个例子里的「不可退还的税额抵免」怎样改变应纳税额。

examples.en: I highlighted nonrefundable tax credit in the margin beside the worked example.
examples.zh: 我在示例旁边把页边的「不可退还的税额抵免」标了出来。

collocations: qualify for a nonrefundable tax credit

words.enDefinition: a set deduction a US filer may use in place of listing specific deductible expenses

examples.en: The volunteer pointed to the standard deduction line on the sample US return.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看，美国税表样本上「美国标准扣除额」对应哪一行。

examples.en: The worksheet compares the standard deduction with the total of the listed expenses.
examples.zh: 计算表比较了「美国标准扣除额」和列出的各项支出总额。

collocations: the amount of the standard deduction

words.enDefinition: specific expenses listed individually as deductions on a US tax return

examples.en: The example includes a separate schedule showing how itemized deductions are recorded.
examples.zh: 示例附有一张单独的表，说明如何记录「逐项列举的扣除额」。

examples.en: I asked why the worksheet compared itemized deductions with one fixed amount.
examples.zh: 我问为什么计算表要把「逐项列举的扣除额」与一个固定金额比较。

words.enDefinition: a cost that applicable rules allow a taxpayer to subtract in a tax calculation

examples.en: The tutor gave an example of a deductible expense on a practice form.
examples.zh: 导师在练习表上举了一个「可扣除支出」的例子。

examples.en: I asked whether the brochure defined deductible expense on another page of the guide.
examples.zh: 我问那本手册是不是在别的页面定义了「可扣除支出」。

words.enDefinition: in the UK, the amount of income someone may receive before paying income tax

examples.en: The UK guide showed the personal allowance in a section about taxable income.
examples.zh: 英国指南在应税收入一节介绍了「英国个人免税额」。

examples.en: I asked why the personal allowance in the sample differed between two people.
examples.zh: 我问为什么样例里两个人的「英国个人免税额」不一样。

collocations: the amount of your personal allowance

words.enDefinition: the part of a payment or amount that is subject to a particular tax

examples.en: The statement displayed the taxable portion separately from the full payment amount.
examples.zh: 报表把「应税部分」和这笔款项的总额分开显示。

examples.en: I asked the volunteer where the taxable portion came from in the example.
examples.zh: 我问志愿者，示例里的「应税部分」是怎么得出来的。

collocations: the taxable portion of a payment

words.enDefinition: to retain part of a payment for transfer to a tax authority

examples.en: The guide explains which line employers use when they withhold tax from wages.
examples.zh: 指南说明，雇主从工资里「预扣税款」时用哪一栏。

examples.en: My supervisor directed my question about whether they withhold tax to the payroll office.
examples.zh: 我问会不会「预扣税款」，主管让我去咨询薪资部门。

words.enDefinition: to report an amount on a tax form to reduce the income or amount taxed

examples.en: The example shows where a student might claim a deduction on the form.
examples.zh: 例子说明学生可能会在表格的哪个位置「申报扣除额」。

examples.en: I asked what records the guide mentioned for people who claim a deduction.
examples.zh: 我问指南提到，「申报扣除额」的人需要哪些材料。

collocations: claim a deduction on a return

words.enDefinition: to request a reduction in tax owed by reporting an eligible credit

examples.en: The example shows where someone would claim a tax credit on the form.
examples.zh: 示例说明了可以在表格哪个位置「申报税额抵免」。

examples.en: I asked whether the guide explains how to claim a tax credit for tuition.
examples.zh: 我问指南有没有说明怎样「申报税额抵免」来抵扣符合条件的学费。

collocations: eligible to claim a tax credit
claim a tax credit on a return
claim a tax credit for tuition

words.enDefinition: to disclose the amount or source of income on a required form

examples.en: The volunteer showed where students who do casual work can report income in the example.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看，打零工的学生应在样表的什么位置「申报收入」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked readers to report income from two different kinds of work.
examples.zh: 计算表要求读者「申报收入」，分别填上两种工作赚的钱。

words.enDefinition: to send a completed tax return to the relevant authority

examples.en: I asked whether students could file a tax return through the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我问学生能不能通过学校的税务咨询点「提交纳税申报表」。

examples.en: The orientation guide listed places where students can get help to file a tax return.
examples.zh: 迎新指南列出了可帮助学生「提交纳税申报表」的地点。

collocations: file a tax return on time
prepare to file a tax return

words.enDefinition: the last date on which a return can be submitted on time

examples.en: My calendar reminder showed the tax filing deadline beside two assignment dates.
examples.zh: 日历提醒把「报税截止日期」显示在两个作业截止日旁边。

examples.en: The website lists a different tax filing deadline for the example we discussed.
examples.zh: 网站为我们讨论的情况列了一个不同的「报税截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: extra time granted to submit a required filing, such as a tax return

examples.en: The leaflet explains how a filing extension changes the date the return is due.
examples.zh: 说明单介绍了「报税延期」会怎样改变税表的提交日期。

examples.en: I asked whether the filing extension applied to both forms in the case study.
examples.zh: 我问案例中的「报税延期」是否对两张表都适用。

collocations: a filing extension for a return

words.enDefinition: to submit a tax return through an approved electronic system

examples.en: The clinic showed us how the confirmation looks after people e-file a return.
examples.zh: 税务咨询点给我们看了「电子报税」后收到的确认信息是什么样的。

examples.en: I asked whether I could e-file using the software shown at the workshop.
examples.zh: 我问能不能用讲座演示的软件「电子报税」。

words.enDefinition: a tax return submitted as printed documents instead of through an electronic system

examples.en: The example compares the confirmation for a paper return with an electronic receipt.
examples.zh: 这个例子把「纸质纳税申报表」的回执和电子回执做了对比。

examples.en: I asked which address was printed on the sample paper return at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问税务咨询点的「纸质纳税申报表」样本上印了哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: in the US, a category based largely on marital and family circumstances that affects tax filing

examples.en: The US tax workshop compared the filing status shown on two sample returns.
examples.zh: 美国税务讲座对比了两张税表样本上的「报税身份类别」。

examples.en: I asked which page of the handbook explained the available filing status categories.
examples.zh: 我问手册在哪一页介绍可用的「报税身份类别」。

words.enDefinition: a tax return submitted to correct information on an earlier return

examples.en: The software listed my original return and the amended return under different dates.
examples.zh: 软件把我的原申报表和「更正申报表」列在了不同日期下。

examples.en: I asked whether the confirmation email referred to my amended return for last year.
examples.zh: 我问确认邮件说的是不是我去年的「更正申报表」。

words.enDefinition: a notice from a tax authority summarizing its assessment of a taxpayer's return or liability

examples.en: The Canadian workshop used a sample notice of assessment to explain the revised figures.
examples.zh: 加拿大税务讲座用「税务评估通知」样本解释了更正后的数字。

examples.en: I found the notice of assessment in the agency's message centre after signing in.
examples.zh: 登录后，我在税务部门的消息中心找到了「税务评估通知」。

words.enDefinition: an official record showing selected information about tax returns or accounts

examples.en: The office asked which type of tax transcript my housing application had requested.
examples.zh: 办事员问，我的住房申请要求的是哪种「税务记录摘录」。

examples.en: I requested a tax transcript after discovering that my saved copy was incomplete.
examples.zh: 发现留存的副本不全之后，我申请了一份「税务记录摘录」。

words.enDefinition: software that helps users prepare a return and may also allow them to submit it

examples.en: The library workshop included a short demonstration of the tax software students could use.
examples.zh: 图书馆讲座简短演示了学生可以使用的「报税软件」。

examples.en: The tax software saved my draft, so I finished it later at home.
examples.zh: 「报税软件」保存了我的草稿，我后来回家把它填完了。

collocations: prepare a return with tax software

words.enDefinition: a person who prepares tax returns for others

examples.en: I asked the tax preparer for a written list of documents they needed.
examples.zh: 我请「报税代办人员」列个书面清单，说明需要哪些材料。

examples.en: The appointment email included the tax preparer contact details at the bottom.
examples.zh: 预约邮件底部写着「报税代办人员」的联系方式。

words.enDefinition: an identifying number used by a tax authority to keep records for a taxpayer

examples.en: The guide explains which field is for the taxpayer identification number on this form.
examples.zh: 指南说明了表格中哪一栏填写「纳税人识别号码」。

examples.en: The volunteer said the taxpayer identification number could appear under different labels in different countries.
examples.zh: 志愿者说，各国表格上「纳税人识别号码」的栏名可能不同。

words.enDefinition: a US federal tax processing number for people who need a US taxpayer number and cannot get a Social Security number

examples.en: The volunteer explained why the sample form listed an individual taxpayer identification number.
examples.zh: 志愿者解释了样表为什么列着一个「美国个人纳税识别号」。

examples.en: I heard the term individual taxpayer identification number during a workshop on US forms.
examples.zh: 我在美国税表讲座上听到了「美国个人纳税识别号」这个术语。

collocations: apply for an individual taxpayer identification number
an individual taxpayer identification number application
renew an individual taxpayer identification number

words.enDefinition: the status of being treated as a resident of a place under its tax rules

examples.en: Tax residency was discussed separately from visa status at the international student workshop.
examples.zh: 国际学生讲座把「税务居民身份」和签证身份分开介绍。

examples.en: The lecturer used a table to compare tax residency in two example countries.
examples.zh: 讲师用一张表比较了两个示例国家认定的「税务居民身份」。

words.enDefinition: a person treated as resident under the tax rules that apply to them

examples.en: The example asked whether the student was a resident for tax purposes that year.
examples.zh: 例子要求判断这名学生当年是不是「税务居民」。

examples.en: I asked where the guide defined the term resident for tax purposes.
examples.zh: 我问指南在哪里定义了「税务居民」这一术语。

collocations: be a resident for tax purposes
treated as a resident for tax purposes
qualify as a resident for tax purposes

words.enDefinition: a person who does not meet the applicable tax rules for being treated as a resident

examples.en: The workshop described the person in this example as a nonresident for tax purposes.
examples.zh: 讲座把这个例子里的人归为「税务非居民」。

examples.en: I wrote down the phrase nonresident for tax purposes from the handout.
examples.zh: 我把讲义上的「税务非居民」这个短语记了下来。

collocations: be a nonresident for tax purposes
classified as a nonresident for tax purposes
treated as a nonresident for tax purposes

words.enDefinition: an agreement between jurisdictions about how specified taxes apply across their borders

examples.en: The adviser mentioned a tax treaty while discussing the example involving two countries.
examples.zh: 顾问在讲解涉及两个国家的例子时提到了一份「税收协定」。

examples.en: The handout shows where the tax treaty was cited in the sample letter.
examples.zh: 讲义指出了示例信在哪里引用了「税收协定」。

words.enDefinition: a document from a tax authority confirming tax residency for a specified period

examples.en: The international office explained who issued the certificate of tax residence in our example.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室解释了例子中的「税收居民身份证明」由谁签发。

examples.en: I asked what period the certificate of tax residence on the screen covered.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的「税收居民身份证明」涵盖哪段时间。

collocations: request a certificate of tax residence
issue a certificate of tax residence
provide a certificate of tax residence

words.enDefinition: taxation of the same income or underlying amount twice, often by different jurisdictions

examples.en: The lecturer drew two arrows to illustrate double taxation in the sample case.
examples.zh: 讲师画了两个箭头，说明案例中的「双重征税」。

examples.en: Our handout introduced double taxation before discussing tax treaties in the next section.
examples.zh: 讲义先介绍「双重征税」，下一节才讲税收协定。

words.enDefinition: income received from sources outside the country or jurisdiction in question

examples.en: The example showed foreign income in a separate row from local wages.
examples.zh: 示例把「境外收入」和本地工资分行列出。

examples.en: I asked which currency the form used for the foreign income field.
examples.zh: 我问表格的「境外收入」一栏使用哪种货币。

words.enDefinition: a tax credit allowed for certain taxes paid to another jurisdiction

examples.en: The worksheet listed a foreign tax credit beside the income earned abroad.
examples.zh: 计算表在境外所得旁边列了一笔「境外税额抵免」。

examples.en: The lecturer explained the foreign tax credit in a case about two countries taxing wages.
examples.zh: 讲师用两国同时对工资征税的案例解释了「境外税额抵免」。

words.enDefinition: the annual period for which income and tax are calculated under a tax system

examples.en: I accidentally downloaded the form for the previous tax year on my first attempt.
examples.zh: 我第一次下载时，不小心下成了上一「纳税年度」的表格。

examples.en: The records are divided by tax year in the agency's online account.
examples.zh: 税务机关的在线账号按「纳税年度」整理记录。

collocations: the end of the tax year

words.enDefinition: a government agency that administers or collects taxes

examples.en: The letter gave the number for the tax authority that reviews these returns.
examples.zh: 信上写了审核这类申报表的「税务机关」的电话号码。

examples.en: We checked which tax authority had issued the notice before returning the form.
examples.zh: 我们先查了通知是哪个「税务机关」发的，然后才寄回表格。

collocations: submit records to a tax authority

words.enDefinition: an acknowledgment that a filing has been received or accepted at a processing stage

examples.en: I kept my filing confirmation with the final version of the tax return.
examples.zh: 我把「申报回执」和最终版纳税申报表保存在一起。

examples.en: The filing confirmation appeared on the screen shortly after I submitted the form.
examples.zh: 我提交表格后没多久，屏幕就显示了「申报回执」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement with the party owed money that sets when and how it will be paid

examples.en: The notice gave a separate phone number for questions about a payment arrangement.
examples.zh: 通知上另列了一个电话，专门解答「付款安排」方面的问题。

examples.en: I found the first instalment date in the tax agency's letter confirming the payment arrangement.
examples.zh: 我在税务机关确认「付款安排」的信里找到了第一期的日期。

words.enDefinition: a penalty charged for missing the deadline to submit a required return

examples.en: The notice listed a late filing penalty below the original amount due.
examples.zh: 通知在原有应缴金额下面列了一笔「逾期申报罚款」。

examples.en: I asked the adviser which date was used to determine the late filing penalty.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，计算「逾期申报罚款」时用的是哪个日期。

collocations: the amount of a late filing penalty

words.enDefinition: interest charged on an amount that remains unpaid after its due date

examples.en: The balance changed because the latest notice included late payment interest for two weeks.
examples.zh: 最新通知加上了两周的「逾期付款利息」，所以余额变了。

examples.en: I asked which amount on the notice was late payment interest from last month.
examples.zh: 我问通知上的哪笔金额是上个月的「逾期付款利息」。

words.enDefinition: a form used to supply or document information for withholding tax

examples.en: The orientation guide showed a withholding certificate alongside other forms for new hires.
examples.zh: 迎新指南把「预扣税申报凭证」和其他入职表格放在一起展示。

examples.en: The payroll clerk asked which year appeared on the withholding certificate I had received.
examples.zh: 薪资部门的办事员问，我收到的「预扣税申报凭证」上写的是哪一年。

words.enDefinition: a US employer's annual statement of a worker's wages and taxes withheld

examples.en: I downloaded Form W-2 from my former employer's portal after checking the year.
examples.zh: 我核对年份后，从前雇主的平台下载了「美国工资及预扣税表」。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the box on Form W-2 that listed the wages.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，「美国工资及预扣税表」上哪一格列的是工资。

collocations: request a copy of Form W-2

words.enDefinition: the US form employees use to give employers information for calculating federal income tax withholding

examples.en: The new hire packet included Form W-4 and a note about federal withholding.
examples.zh: 入职资料包里有「美国雇员预扣税表」，附有一份联邦预扣税说明。

examples.en: The onboarding portal labelled Form W-4 separately from the direct deposit form.
examples.zh: 入职平台把「美国雇员预扣税表」和工资直存表分开标注。

words.zhGloss: 美国外国人收入与预扣税表
words.enDefinition: a US information form for certain US-source payments to foreign persons and any related tax withheld
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国外国人收入与预扣税表

examples.en: The university told me when Form 1042-S would be available in the student portal.
examples.zh: 学校告诉我什么时候能在学生平台上看到「美国外国人收入与预扣税表」。

examples.en: I asked which scholarship payment the university had reported on Form 1042-S.
examples.zh: 我问学校在「美国外国人收入与预扣税表」上申报的是哪一笔奖学金。

words.zhGloss: 美国非居民个人所得税申报表
words.enDefinition: the US federal income tax return used by certain taxpayers classified as nonresident aliens
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国非居民个人所得税申报表

examples.en: The US tax session used a blank Form 1040-NR to show the main sections.
examples.zh: 美国税务说明会用一张空白「美国非居民个人所得税申报表」展示了主要栏目。

examples.en: I asked the volunteer which year the sample Form 1040-NR was for.
examples.zh: 我问志愿者，「美国非居民个人所得税申报表」样本是哪一年的。

words.enDefinition: a UK document from an employer that records pay and tax information when an employee leaves

examples.en: My former employer sent the P45 after my last shift at the café.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡店上完最后一班后，原雇主寄来了「英国离职薪税表」。

examples.en: I asked which leaving date was recorded on the P45 in my folder.
examples.zh: 我问文件夹里的「英国离职薪税表」登记的离职日期是哪天。

collocations: give your new employer a P45

words.enDefinition: a UK statement summarizing an employee's pay and tax deductions for a completed tax year

examples.en: My UK employer put the P60 in the same folder as my payslips.
examples.zh: 我的英国雇主把「英国年度薪税表」放在工资单所在的文件夹里。

examples.en: I looked at the P60 when checking my pay records for the year.
examples.zh: 我核对全年工资记录时看了「英国年度薪税表」。

collocations: keep a copy of your P60

words.zhGloss: 英国随工资预扣税制度
words.enDefinition: short for Pay As You Earn, a system used in the UK to collect income tax through payroll
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国随工资预扣税制度

examples.en: The UK payslip uses PAYE as the label for the income tax deduction.
examples.zh: 那张英国工资单把所得税扣款一栏标成「英国随工资预扣税制度」的缩写 PAYE。

examples.en: I heard about PAYE when the campus jobs team explained the sample payslip.
examples.zh: 校内就业团队讲解工资单样本时，我听到了「英国随工资预扣税制度」。

words.enDefinition: in the UK payroll context, a code used to determine how much income tax to deduct

examples.en: The tax code had changed by the time I downloaded my next payslip.
examples.zh: 等我下载下一张工资单时，「工资计税代码」已经变了。

examples.en: I found my tax code beside my payroll number near the top.
examples.zh: 我在接近顶部的地方看到，「工资计税代码」就在薪资编号旁边。

collocations: a change in your tax code

words.enDefinition: payments into the UK's National Insurance system that help build eligibility for certain benefits

examples.en: The sample payslip lists National Insurance contributions separately from the amount of income tax.
examples.zh: 工资单样本把「英国国民保险缴费」和所得税金额分开列出。

examples.en: I asked what the National Insurance contributions line meant on my UK statement.
examples.zh: 我问英国工资单上「英国国民保险缴费」那一栏是什么意思。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大受雇收入税务单
words.enDefinition: a Canadian statement from an employer listing employment income and certain deductions for a calendar year
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大受雇收入税务单

examples.en: The T4 slip from my library job arrived in the employee portal.
examples.zh: 图书馆工作的「加拿大受雇收入税务单」发到了员工平台。

examples.en: I compared the year on the T4 slip with my saved Canadian pay stubs.
examples.zh: 我拿「加拿大受雇收入税务单」上的年份和保存的加拿大工资单对照了一下。

collocations: employment income on a T4 slip

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学费与注册证明
words.enDefinition: a Canadian tax certificate showing eligible tuition and enrolment information from an educational institution
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学费与注册证明

examples.en: I found the T2202 in a separate section of my university's billing portal.
examples.zh: 我在学校缴费平台的另一个栏目找到了「加拿大学费与注册证明」。

examples.en: The finance office explained which enrolment information appeared on the T2202 for that year.
examples.zh: 财务办公室解释了当年的「加拿大学费与注册证明」列了哪些注册信息。

collocations: request a copy of your T2202

words.enDefinition: Australian tax withheld by employers or other payers from certain payments

examples.en: The Australian payslip labelled the income tax amount as PAYG withholding under deductions.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的工资单在扣款项下把所得税标为「澳大利亚PAYG预扣税」。

examples.en: Our workshop showed where PAYG withholding appeared on an Australian income statement.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了澳大利亚收入报表上「澳大利亚PAYG预扣税」列在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a US tuition statement issued by an eligible educational institution for tax reporting purposes

examples.en: The university added Form 1098-T to the account I use for tuition payments.
examples.zh: 学校把「美国学费税务记录表」发到了我用来缴学费的账号里。

examples.en: I asked about a charge that appeared on my bill but not on Form 1098-T.
examples.zh: 我问为什么有一笔费用出现在账单上，却没出现在「美国学费税务记录表」里。

words.enDefinition: a service, often staffed by trained volunteers, that helps people with tax questions or returns

examples.en: The student union posted the opening hours for its free tax clinic.
examples.zh: 学生会公布了免费「报税咨询点」的开放时间。

examples.en: I brought a folder of pay records to my appointment at the tax clinic.
examples.zh: 去「报税咨询点」赴约时，我带了一整册工资记录。

collocations: book an appointment at a tax clinic

words.enDefinition: the part of the year when many people prepare and file annual tax returns

examples.en: The campus tax clinic needed extra volunteers when tax season got busy.
examples.zh: 进入繁忙的「集中报税期」后，学校税务咨询点需要增加志愿者。

examples.en: I collected all my wage records a few weeks before tax season began.
examples.zh: 「集中报税期」开始前几周，我就收齐了工资记录。

words.enDefinition: the processing of wages and deductions for a group of workers at one time

examples.en: The corrected hours will be included in the next payroll run, the clerk said.
examples.zh: 办事员说，更正后的工时会纳入下一轮「薪资结算」。

examples.en: Our manager checked the timesheets before the payroll run at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末那一轮「薪资结算」开始前，经理核对了工时表。

words.enDefinition: an amount subtracted from wages for a pension plan

examples.en: My first pension deduction appeared after I received the confirmation of enrolment.
examples.zh: 收到加入计划的确认后，我第一次在工资单上看到「养老金缴费扣款」。

examples.en: The clerk explained why the pension deduction had changed on the corrected statement.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了为什么更正后的工资单上「养老金缴费扣款」变了。

words.zhGloss: 用于计算养老金的收入
words.enDefinition: the portion of earnings used to determine pension contributions or benefits under a particular plan
acceptedZhAnswers: 用于计算养老金的收入

examples.en: The statement shows pensionable earnings in a separate column beside my gross pay.
examples.zh: 工资单在工资总额旁边另列了一栏「用于计算养老金的收入」。

examples.en: I asked payroll which part of my wages counted as pensionable earnings.
examples.zh: 我问薪资部门，工资中哪一部分算「用于计算养老金的收入」。

words.enDefinition: a change that fixes an error in the logged dates or hours of work

examples.en: My supervisor approved a time entry correction after I mentioned the missing hour.
examples.zh: 我提到漏记的一个小时后，主管批准了「工时记录更正」。

examples.en: The payroll office asked me to attach the schedule to my time entry correction.
examples.zh: 薪资部门请我在「工时记录更正」里附上排班表。

words.enDefinition: a short label that identifies the kind of pay entered on a wage record

examples.en: The letter beside the amount was an earnings code for evening shifts.
examples.zh: 金额旁边的字母是晚班的「工资项目代码」。

examples.en: The portal included a short list of each earnings code and its meaning.
examples.zh: 平台上有一张简表，列着各个「工资项目代码」及其含义。

words.enDefinition: an amount the law requires an employer to deduct from pay

examples.en: The payroll guide used a sample statutory deduction to explain the layout.
examples.zh: 薪资指南用一项「法定扣款」的例子说明了工资单的版面。

examples.en: I asked whether the line described a statutory deduction or a staff contribution.
examples.zh: 我问这一栏写的是「法定扣款」，还是员工自愿缴纳的款项。

words.enDefinition: money an employee agrees to have taken out of their pay

examples.en: A voluntary deduction for the staff fund appeared on my first payslip.
examples.zh: 我的第一张工资单上列了一项给员工基金的「自愿扣款」。

examples.en: I asked where the voluntary deduction was listed in the summary of my pay.
examples.zh: 我问工资摘要中哪一栏列的是那笔「自愿扣款」。

words.enDefinition: hours that do not count toward paid time in a work or payroll record

examples.en: The statement showed three unpaid hours for the afternoon I took off.
examples.zh: 工资单上写着，我那天下午请了三个小时，计入「无薪时数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unpaid hours listed there were for my scheduled breaks.
examples.zh: 我问那里列的「无薪时数」是不是指排班里的休息时间。
